summary.headline: Mars in the Zodiac Signs
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Mars appearing in Aries through Libra, covering weather, crops, disease, prices, warfare, famine, and regional events. Hermes is cited for eastern or evening appearances, and Mercury’s proximity to Mars is associated with sedition in the south.
